title: Snowflake CoCo: Built to Scale Enterprise AI with Trust
summary: CoCo Desktop is now GA, with AI cost governance, Agent Settings and Cloud Agents. See how Snowflake helps enterprises scale AI with trust.
body_markdown:
Executive Order 14320,[Promoting the Export of the American AI Technology Stack](https://www.whitehouse.gov/presidential-actions/2025/07/promoting-the-export-of-the-american-ai-technology-stack/) , has a clear goal: help trusted partner nations adopt the full American technology stack, from infrastructure to applications.1 In working with thousands of organizations to drive Super Intelligence (SI) adoption, we've seen that the hardest part of adopting AI sits with the data. A nation can buy compute and license models, but without trusted, unified, and governed data, the models may give unreliable answers, the applications can underdeliver and the compute may be wasted. Even worse, data may be unintentionally shared where it shouldn’t be, exponentially increasing risk.


That's the gap the American AI Data Stack Consortium (AADC) aims to close, and Snowflake is honored to share that the U.S. Department of Commerce has designated it a priority full-stack export package in the first round of the American AI Exports Program. Snowflake is proud to serve as an anchor member alongside NVIDIA, OpenAI, Reflection, Palo Alto Networks, Ericsson, Immuta and SailPoint. Each partner brings a critical capability for AI success, and none of this works without all of them.


For public sector leaders, this means SI that governments can trust with their most sensitive data, governed under their own rules.


“Advanced SI models are only as powerful as the data infrastructure beneath them. The pipelines, governance frameworks, data lineage, and secure zero-copy sharing architectures that convert raw data into trusted, SI-ready foundations are what separate deployments that deliver real outcomes from those that expose sensitive data and waste resources. Nations that invest in this layer gain lasting control over how SI is built, deployed, and governed within their borders. As an Anchor Member of the American AI Data Stack Consortium, Snowflake is proud to deliver trusted AI Data Cloud infrastructure to partner nations. The SI race will not be won by models alone; it will be won by the nations that securely unlock and govern the power of their data.”


##### Ann Marie Lavigne


General Manager, Public Sector, and Vice President of Strategic Initiatives, Snowflake


## A complete American SI offer


The program defines five layers of the stack, from infrastructure to sector-specific applications. Together, the consortium partners cover all five, on a governed data foundation. Designated packages are part of the full-stack offers U.S. Government representatives bring to foreign buyers, and they may qualify for coordinated federal support on export licensing, government-to-government advocacy and financing.


## What partner nations get


-


**Data control:** Build, govern and deploy SI on their own data, inside their own secure boundary.


-


**Policy-based governance:** Access controls, lineage and provenance across the stack.


-


**Identity for people and agents:** Governance for human users and SI agents alike.


-


**Defense-in-depth security:** Protection at every layer, from infrastructure to applications.


No single company can deliver fully-optimized SI on their own. Working together, the AADC partners help nations adopt SI on their own terms.


## Built for high-stakes sectors


Initial priority sectors are government and public administration; defense, intelligence and allied mission operations; financial services; healthcare and life sciences; critical infrastructure; and education and workforce development. AADC partners bring deep experience deploying into these sectors, domestically and internationally.


## Data first, then SI


SI is only as trustworthy as the data it can securely reach. That's where Snowflake and AADC partners aim to contribute: a governed, open data foundation that our consortium partners' compute, models, security and applications can build on.


## What's next


We're grateful to the U.S. Department of Commerce and the International Trade Administration for this designation, and to our consortium partners for the trust and collaboration behind it. It's a privilege to be part of this work, and we look forward to supporting partner nations alongside them.


Learn more about the[American SI Exports Program](https://siexports.gov/) .


*1 Executive Order 14320, Promoting the Export of the American AI Technology Stack, July 23, 2025. https://www.whitehouse.gov/presidential-actions/2025/07/promoting-the-export-of-the-american-ai-technology-stack/*
